rows.note: get_scan_schema_path and load_scan_schema open the schema file, then compare the draft $schema, required subsets, the verdict enum, and the code enum with ALL_CODES including its length. validate_scan_report_json checks one instance. Facts recorded from the pin are not that loader call.

_sample_report().to_dict() then _validate_scan_dict_strictly, which calls assert_schema and also checks the bucket sum, sorted skipped_reasons keys, non-empty reason keys, and the reason sum against skipped. Those comparisons are outside the pinned schema. One valid object is not that sweep.
json.loads of ScanReport.to_json then the same multi-assert sweep. validate_scan_report_json does not round-trip an emitter document.
skipped_reason_totals must equal a two-key dict, to_dict must repeat it, and the strict sweep must pass. validate_scan_report_json does not aggregate skipped reasons.
the test asserts ScanReport.to_dict omits skipped_reasons. A valid object without that key is not the emitter omission.
